verdict.rationale: The only memory detail in the pack is a community commenter stating Gaudi 3 uses 8 stacks of HBM2e at about 3.7TB/s. That suggests memory type and bandwidth are publicly known, but none of the first-party Intel or Habana pages in the pack publish memory specs. Missing for 10: first-party spec sheet evidence, memory capacity, bus width, and vendor-documented bandwidth figures.
